target_customer: Consulting firms and in-house consulting teams
problem: Consultants will direct agents that carry whole workstreams, but firms lack infrastructure tuned to their methods and client data. Foaster's forward deployed engineers configure and run that infrastructure.
business_model: Services-heavy B2B platform with forward deployed engineers; pricing not found

founders.name: Raphaël Dabadie
prior_employers: Rafael Nadal's team (agent, per YC page)
previous_startups: AI consultancy with co-founder (outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: grew a tennis fan community to over 400,000, TEDx speaker at 23, co-authored two 2025 LLM benchmarks.

founders.name: Alexandre Combes
previous_startups: Répondia, AI agents handling 60,000+ restaurant calls in France (outcome not found)

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent orchestration, knowledge graphs per client and on-premise deployments are standard but integration heavy; the company relies on forward deployed engineers.

defensibility.rationale: Per-firm knowledge layers and embedded engineers could create lock-in, but the stack builds on commodity models and big consulting firms build in-house tools.

incumbents: Large consulting firms building in-house AI platforms
takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not determined; the competitor search returned only unrelated sales AI companies.

market_need_then: The founders say they ran more than 20 consulting engagements during YC using AI-led interviews and found demand for the human side to stay with consultants; this is a company claim.

identity.voice_and_tone: Visionary: For teams setting a new standard in consulting.

branding.community_and_virality: Co-founder Dabadie says he built a 400,000 member tennis fan community as a child and has widely read consulting essays (YC page, self-reported); not tied to the Foaster brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct coinage similar to foster and Foster's, no meaning stated, and brand searches returned nothing about the company.

outcome_analysis: Foaster is a Spring 2026 YC company that began as an AI native consulting practice and now sells infrastructure to consulting firms. Two founders with a track record of building audiences and benchmarks run it. No outcome news and no verified funding were found, so the story is still open.
notes: Funding unverified: FundedIQ and Caplight report $500K from YC in June 2026, YesPress reports $130K seed; none confirmed, none recorded. Competitor search found no dated consulting-agent infrastructure peers, so the list is empty. First foaster.ai fetch was rate limited; a second succeeded. Founded year and education not found. Some aggregators label the batch P26. The recorded 500K pre-seed rests on FundedIQ and VCBacked databases; Yespress reports 130K, so amounts conflict.
